{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last caught up, and I wanted to check in on how things are going at Braintrust. I'd love to hear what the team has been focused on and what's ahead for you.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call whenever suits you. No agenda, just a chance to catch up and hear what you're building.

Hope you and the team are doing well.

Best,
Sam"}
